topics.name: ASSESS PRIOR KNOWLEDGE GRADE 8 & 9
subtopics: Assess bookkeeping concepts and procedures covered in Grade 8 and 9

topics.name: INFORMAL/INDIGENOUS BOOKKEEPING
subtopics: Compare bookkeeping of informal vs formal sectors: capital, fixed assets, stock, cost price, labour cost, selling price, income, expenses, profit
Management of resources; relate current procedures to indigenous practices
topics.prior_knowledge: Define informal and formal business sectors

topics.name: INTERNAL CONTROL, ETHICS, GAAP
subtopics: Internal control: meaning and basic processes (control environment, risk assessment, control activities, information systems and communication, monitoring)
Code of ethics for all parties in the financial environment (leadership, discipline, transparency, accountability, fairness, sustainability, responsible management)
GAAP principles: historical cost, prudence, materiality, business entity rule, going concern, matching

Accounting concepts up to financial statements: sole trader, debit/credit, equity, capital, assets, liabilities, ledger, journal, profit/loss, discounts, final accounts, accounting cycle, financial vs managerial accounting, perpetual inventory system
topics.prior_knowledge: Background of GAAP; background/importance of internal control and ethics in any business

topics.name: BOOKKEEPING OF A SOLE TRADER: CASH TRANSACTIONS (CRJ, CPJ, PCJ, GENERAL LEDGER, TRIAL BALANCE, ACCOUNTING EQUATION)
subtopics: Accounting cycle on the perpetual inventory system: source documents, journals (CRJ, CPJ, PCJ), double-entry principle in the ledger
Complete CRJ, CPJ, PCJ in the correct format; effect of cash transactions on the accounting equation
Post to general ledger (balance sheet and nominal accounts sections); trial balance in the correct format
Integrate internal control and ethics: handling of stock, cash management, control over fixed assets
topics.prior_knowledge: Revise the accounting cycle; Gr 8-9 source documents, journals, general-ledger posting and trial balance; note payments shifted from cheques to EFT

topics.name: BOOKKEEPING OF A SOLE TRADER: CREDIT TRANSACTIONS (DJ, DAJ, CJ, CAJ, GJ, DEBTORS AND CREDITORS LEDGERS, TRIAL BALANCE, ACCOUNTING EQUATION)
subtopics: Credit transactions: DJ, CJ, DAJ, CAJ
Posting to general, debtors and creditors ledgers; trial balance
Effect of transactions on the accounting equation of a sole trader
Internal control and ethics: handling debtors and creditors (managing credit)
topics.prior_knowledge: Revise Gr 8-9 content on source documents, relevant journals and posting to the general, debtors and creditors ledgers

topics.name: BOOKKEEPING OF THE SOLE TRADER: COMBINED CASH AND CREDIT TRANSACTIONS
subtopics: Prepare all journals (CRJ, CPJ, DJ, DAJ, CJ, CAJ) from given information
Introduce the General Journal: bad debts, interest on overdue accounts, corrections of errors
Posting to GL, DL and CL; trial balance
Analyse control accounts (debtors and creditors); accounting-equation analysis

sba: Task 2: Control test 1 (100 marks, 1.5 hours; term 1 work; week 11)

topics.name: BOOKKEEPING OF A SOLE TRADER (COMBINED CASH AND CREDIT TRANSACTIONS)
subtopics: Combined cash and credit activities: journals, subsidiary and general ledger posting, trial balance
Effect of transactions on the accounting equation
Integrated internal control and ethics: stock, debtors, creditors and cash; ethical scenarios (accountability and transparency)
topics.prior_knowledge: Cash and credit transactions; double-entry principle; the accounting cycle

topics.name: DEBTORS AND CREDITORS RECONCILIATION
subtopics: Analyse debtors and creditors control accounts and compare with lists
Prepare debtors' and creditors' lists to reconcile with the control accounts
Identify and correct errors and omissions
topics.prior_knowledge: Control accounts in the general ledger and subsidiary ledgers

topics.name: SALARIES AND WAGES
subtopics: Calculations using salary/wage scales, notch increases and deductions
Record salaries and wages in the SJ and WJ; payments in the CPJ (manual or spreadsheet)
Normal time and overtime; deductions: PAYE, pension fund, UIF, medical aid, union membership
Employer contributions: pension fund, UIF, medical aid, skills development levy
Ethics: salary/wage contracts, nepotism, payment in line with responsibilities, role of trade unions
topics.prior_knowledge: Concepts and differences between salaries and wages covered in Gr 8 or 9

topics.name: YEAR-END ACCOUNTING PROCEDURES, PRE- AND POST-ADJUSTMENT TRIAL BALANCE, FINAL ACCOUNTS
subtopics: Emphasis on the accounting cycle; year-end processes before financial statements
Related concepts and application of GAAP
Final accounts; introducing adjustments
Depreciation (straight-line and diminishing balance): rate, additions during the year, asset register
topics.prior_knowledge: Accounting cycle, GAAP principles and basic accounting concepts (income, expenses, profit, loss)

sba: Task 3: Project - formal bookkeeping, manual or electronic (50 marks; weeks 4-5)
Task 4: June examination (150 x 2 papers = 300 marks, 2 hours each; weeks 10-11)

topics.name: YEAR-END ACCOUNTING PROCEDURES, PRE- AND POST- ADJUSTMENT TRIAL BALANCE, FINAL ACCOUNTS
subtopics: Adjustments (after depreciation): trading stock deficit/surplus, consumable stores on hand, accrued income, accrued expenses, prepaid expenses, income received in advance, interest capitalised, corrections of errors/omissions
Post-adjustment trial balance in the correct format
Final accounts showing gross and net profit; post-closing trial balance
topics.prior_knowledge: Depreciation; GAAP principles, year-end adjustments and the accounting cycle

topics.name: PREPARATION OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
subtopics: Statement of comprehensive income: format, nominal vs balance sheet accounts, headings, adjustments with workings
Statement of financial position: format, headings and sub-headings, effect of adjustments (trade and other receivables/payables)
Notes to the financial statements: interest, fixed assets, inventory, trade and other receivables, cash and cash equivalents, owner's equity, trade and other payables
Apply GAAP; integrate indigenous bookkeeping
topics.prior_knowledge: Accounting cycle, final accounts, year-end adjustments, GAAP principles

topics.name: ANALYSIS AND INTERPRETATION OF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
subtopics: Profitability: gross profit on sales, gross profit on cost of sales, net profit on sales, operating expenses on sales, operating profit on sales
Liquidity: current ratio, acid-test ratio
Solvency ratio; return on owner's equity
Interpretation: comparing percentages and ratios for meaningful comment; use of the formula sheet
topics.prior_knowledge: Understanding the information in the financial statements

sba: Task 5: Case study - financial statements of a sole trader (50 marks; weeks 7-8)
Task 6: Control test (100 marks, 1.5 hours; term 3 content; week 11)

topics.name: COST ACCOUNTING
subtopics: Manufacturing concepts: direct and indirect material, direct and indirect labour, factory overheads, prime cost, fixed and variable costs, work-in-progress
Emphasis on basic cost calculations
topics.prior_knowledge: Background knowledge of a factory/manufacturing business; inventories, salaries and wages, other expenses

topics.name: BUDGETING
subtopics: Basic budgeting concepts: cash budget, zero-based budget, capital budget, long-term and medium-term budgets
Basic budget calculations
topics.prior_knowledge: Cash vs non-cash items; receipts, payments, income, expenses

sba: Task 7: Final exam (two papers of 150 marks, 2 hours each)

paper1.discipline: Discipline 1: Recording, reporting and evaluation of financial statements

paper2.discipline: Discipline 2: Internal management and control processes

notes: Papers written on different dates; Grade 10 formula sheet provided
Cognitive levels: 30% basic, 40% moderately high, 30% higher order; 10-15% problem-solving questions
